answer_1.quote: The MNMT task ... aims to translate the source sentence into the target sentence by incorporating additional modalities.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation. Existing automatic evaluation methods for MNMT can be broadly divided into three categories: (1) methods for evaluating the text translation quality of MNMT models; ... N-gram-based compares the generated and reference translations based on word n-grams (e.g., BLEU and METEOR) and character n-grams (e.g., chrF). ... pre-trained model-based derives evaluation metrics based on pre-trained models, which better capture semantic quality, such as COMET and BLEURT.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation has been used to complement automatic evaluation metrics for evaluating MNMT outputs that involve fluency and adequacy assessment and quality estimation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate translations on fluency and adequacy (and overall quality).
